name: c409_15_restore_ck_moved
covers: restore CAS, commit key moved: a bulk page's marker lands between the restoring page's read of the commit key and its write; the restore reports a conflict and writes nothing, so the caller must read again and choose again

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u; A: a: open, commit: a first commit, so the seeded manifest is retained
labels.A: begin BULK commit #2: a: bulk: its marker write (bulk-begin), held until r has read the commit key
labels.RESTORE: begin restore; read commit key: r: open, restore of the newest retained manifest once a's commit is applied: its read of the commit key
labels.A: BULK step 1: CAS marker -> v3: a: the marker write, applied after r's read
labels.RESTORE: restore CAS ifVersion v2 -> 409: r: the restore's commit-key write, held until the marker is applied: restore:conflict
